windows_coverage.previous: Windows nextest job used default features; Cargo.toml default=[] excludes the HTTP and MCP binaries.
windows_coverage.added_command: cargo nextest run --locked --features server,mcp --no-fail-fast --test-threads 1 --bin warm-server --bin warm-mcp --test server --test server_api --test server_ops --test server_abuse --test server_ann
windows_coverage.status: Initial expanded CI failed compiling an unconditional UnixListener import (run 41194768596). Unix-only variants, imports and cleanup are now platform-guarded; Windows rerun pending.

windows_console.source_finding: Server test harness used Unix kill for every shutdown and SIGHUP reload; Windows server listened only for Ctrl+C.
windows_console.mechanism: Windows child process groups receive targeted Ctrl+Break; server handles it using Tokio. Windows key and certificate reload tests use existing authenticated endpoints. Unix signal coverage is retained.
windows_console.status: Run 41197071913: 159/164 runtime tests passed, including graceful shutdown, drain, readiness, key/TLS reloads and unsupported Unix socket rejection. Five snapshot-related tests failed; required aggregate failed.

snapshot_copy.root_cause: copy_store reopened copied files read-only before sync_all; Windows FlushFileBuffers requires GENERIC_WRITE.
snapshot_copy.fix: Retain native fs::copy on every platform. On Windows temporarily clear the unpublished destination read-only bit only when necessary to open a writable handle, restore attributes before propagating open errors, then flush that handle.
snapshot_copy.regression: snapshot_copy_preserves_read_only_files_and_skips_process_state checks nested data, exact byte count, read-only permissions and lock/compaction exclusions.
snapshot_copy.windows_acceptance: Run 41199300291 passed the new read-only-copy regression and previously access-denied snapshot tests. Overall 162/165 passed; three timing/empty-response failures remain under investigation.
limits: Windows directory sync remains a no-op; this is not a full power-loss durability claim.
Separate core admin migration copy_tree still skips Windows file flushing; not changed here.

native_metadata.finding: The initial unmerged byte-stream implementation omitted NTFS alternate streams; native fs::copy preserves them.
native_metadata.windows_test: The read-only nested-file regression now also writes and verifies an NTFS alternate stream. Windows acceptance pending.
native_metadata.local_check: Read-only-copy test, strict Clippy and formatting pass on macOS.

failures: Idle eviction assumed writes finish in less than one second.
Readiness test attempted requests after its two-second drain window.
Backup round-trip received an empty response under parallel filesystem-heavy tests; precise failed request was not logged.
changes: Eviction receives a private explicit time argument; production uses the same monotonic clock. Test covers idle threshold -1/at/+1 milliseconds without sleeps.
Readiness fixture opens its query tenant before signaling; five-second configured delay retains corresponding 4.9-second minimum assertion.
Fallible polling returns None on connection refusal; ordinary send now includes method, path and last ten server events on empty responses.
Windows service fixtures run serially; all tests and internal multi-client concurrency checks remain enabled. Read timeout remains 20 seconds.
timing_and_polling.baseline_description: Assertion added before changing the polling helper, on the working tree based on 2e01512e.
limits: No production throughput or latency claim.
Empty backup response root cause not confirmed; serialization isolates cross-test contention and diagnostics identify the request if it recurs.
Latest Windows CI required before merge.
